title.ko: 개인정보의 파기 절차 및 방법에 관한 사항

rules.statement: State that personal data is destroyed without delay once it is no longer needed (retention expired or purpose achieved).

When other laws require keeping data instead of destroying it, state the preservation basis, the items the law covers, and the period. This may be omitted here if S05 already states them, with a pointer or link to S05 (recommended).
State the destruction procedure and the destruction method (electronic files made unrecoverable; other media shredded or incinerated).
Where data is preserved under other laws, say it is moved to a separate database or stored apart from other data.
Describe the procedure concretely: who selects data due for destruction and who approves it (for example the privacy officer).

goodPatterns: Clause 1: destroy without delay when retention ends or the purpose is achieved.
Clause 2: data that must be kept under other laws is moved to a separate DB or location; pointer to S05 for items, basis, period.
Clause 3: procedure (select data due for destruction, destroy with the privacy officer's approval) and method (electronic files made unrecoverable; paper shredded or incinerated).

commonDefects.defect: Mentions legal retention but gives no basis/items/period here or in S05.
Method stated only for electronic files, not paper (or vice versa) although both exist.
